description: Normalize RPA output_payload metadata across UiPath / Automation Anywhere / Blue Prism / Power Automate into one flat DataFrame shape (vendor / run_id / status / asset_key / materialized_at / output_field / raw_payload). Downstream extract / classify / AgenticPipeline steps consume a single shape regardless of which bot vendor produced the raw data.

outputs.description: One DataFrame asset with one row per upstream RPA asset (columns: vendor, run_id, status, asset_key, materialized_at, output_field, raw_payload).

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the resulting normalized DataFrame asset.

upstream_asset_keys.label: Upstream Asset Keys
upstream_asset_keys.description: Slash-separated asset keys of upstream RPA assets (from uipath_orchestrator_integration, automation_anywhere_integration, blue_prism_integration, power_automate_integration).

description.label: Description
description.description: Prose description shown in the Dagster UI.

fail_on_missing_upstream.label: Fail On Missing Upstream
fail_on_missing_upstream.description: If true, raise when any upstream has no materialization on record; else emit a row with status='MISSING'.

name: RPAOutputParser
